page_title: LEI 1-0 BOU | Leicester v Bournemouth 05/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' The referee blows his whistle, Bournemouth are awarded a corner kick.
90+5' The ball is behind the touchline and Bournemouth will take a throw-in.
90+4' It will be a corner kick for Bournemouth.
90+2' The game is interrupted. Boubakary Soumare (Leicester) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Steven Cooper prepares a substitution. Jordan Ayew is replaced by Boubakary Soumare (Leicester).
87' Issahaku Fatawu (Leicester) got the ball on the edge of the box and produced a strong shot, but one of his teammates was standing in the wrong place and unintentionally blocked the effort.
84' Darren Bond shows the yellow card to Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) for a heavy challenge.
82' It is time for a substitution. Issahaku Fatawu (Leicester) is on for Stephy Mavididi.
82' Steven Cooper decides to make a substitution. Facundo Buonanotte will be replaced by Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Leicester).
81' A substitution has been made. Evanilson is replaced by David Brooks (Bournemouth).
80' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leicester.
78' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
77' The referee signals a corner kick to Bournemouth.
74' Here is a change. Ryan Christie is going off and Andoni Iraola gives the last tactical orders to Enes Unal (Bournemouth).
74' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jamie Vardy will be replaced by Odsonne Edouard (Leicester).
73' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) latches on to a superb cross inside the box but only hits the crossbar with a fine header. What a chance!
72' Bournemouth hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
68' The game is interrupted as Jamie Vardy (Leicester) is flagged offside.
67' The goal by Bournemouth is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
67' The Bournemouth players halt their celebrations as referee Darren Bond makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
66' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) proves that he is an excellent free-kick taker after finding the back of the net with a clever shot that goes straight into the bottom right corner!
64' The foul by James Justin (Leicester) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Darren Bond.
63' Andoni Iraola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) replacing Milos Kerkez.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alex Scott (Bournemouth) will replace Adam Smith.
62' 2:2 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
60' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bournemouth.
58' The ball is behind the sideline. Victor Kristiansen (Leicester) takes a throw-in.

57' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Darren Bond with no other option than to blow for a foul.

53' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) latches on to a fine cross from the resulting corner and attempts to finish from the edge of the box. His shot, however, misses the target narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Leicester will have a goal kick.
53' The referee points to the corner flag and Bournemouth will take a corner.

52' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom left corner. Mads Hermansen is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
50' Darren Bond shows a yellow card to Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) for a tough tackle.

49' Ilya Zabarnyi (Bournemouth) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He plants a header against the right post and it bounces away off it.
46' Andoni Iraola makes a half-time substitution. Dango Ouattara comes on in place of Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Darren Bond blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Victor Kristiansen (Leicester) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
43' The ball goes out of play and Leicester will have a goal kick.
40' Jordan Ayew (Leicester) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
39' Darren Bond couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Adam Smith (Bournemouth) and blew his whistle. Leicester have a free kick.
37' The linesman signals a throw-in for Leicester.
35' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) fires a shot well wide of the left post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
32' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) inside the box.
31' Rough tackle by Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
29' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bournemouth will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
28' Bournemouth will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
26' Bournemouth force their opponents to concede a corner.

23' What a chance that is! Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes high over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
21' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) commits a rough foul. Darren Bond stops the game and makes a call. There is a free kick near the sideline to Leicester.
21' The ratio of the ball possession is 41:59.
20' The ball is out of play and Bournemouth manage to earn a corner.
18' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) takes a snap shot on the edge of the box, but it sails well wide of the right post.

16' 1 - 0 Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Kepa Arrizabalaga is just a bystander as the ball flies under the crossbar. The score is 1:0.
13' It's a throw-in for Leicester.
11' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

9' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the roof of the net. Kepa Arrizabalaga is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
8' Bournemouth are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.

6' A precise cross aimed towards the penalty spot was met by Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth). He outjumped the defence and produced a decent header which went a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leicester.
4' The ball is out of play. Bournemouth will have a throw-in.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Leicester will take the kick-off.
Darren Bond will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
